blocks.text: Abdullah Hashem Aba Al-Sadiq (From Him is Peace) has fulfilled many of the prophecies of the Mahdi and what he would do and accomplish. His name is written in the Will of Prophet Mohammed (PBUH & His Family), in which Prophet Mohammed (PBUH & His Family) lists out the names of his successors after him, the 12 Imams and the 12 Mahdis after them.
Claiming the Will of Prophet Mohammed (PBUH & His Family) as Abdullah

“Then there will be twelve Mahdis after him, so if death comes to him, let him hand it over to his son, the first of the Mahdis, he has three names, one like mine and my Father’s and it is Abdullah (Servant of God), Ahmed (the Praised), and the third name is Al-Mahdi (the Guided), and he is the first of the believers.”
blocks.source: Ghaybat Al-Tusi, Al-Shaikh Al-Tusi, Vol. 1, p. 174; Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 53, p. 148

sources.extra: Ghaybat Al-Tusi, Al-Shaikh Al-Tusi, Vol. 1, p. 174; Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 53, p. 148

blocks.text: Since the writing of this Will, nobody has claimed to be the “Abdullah” mentioned in it except for Abdullah Hashem Aba Al-Sadiq (From Him is Peace) and that is because it is a Will that is a protection from misguidance. Imam Al-Sadiq (From Him is Peace) said,
“This matter will not be claimed except by the rightful owner, or else Allah will cut off his age.”
blocks.source: Al-Kafi, Al-Shaikh Al-Kulayni, Vol. 1, p. 373; Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 25, p. 112

sources.extra: Al-Kafi, Al-Shaikh Al-Kulayni, Vol. 1, p. 373; Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 25, p. 112

blocks.text: He also fits the description of the name of the Mahdi in the books of the Sunni: Narrated Abdullah ibn Mas’ud:

The Prophet (PBUH & His Family) said: If only one day of this world remained, Allah would lengthen that day (according to the version of Za’idah), till He raised up in it a man who belongs to me or to my family whose father’s name is the same as my father’s, who will fill the earth with equity and justice as it has been filled with oppression and tyranny.
blocks.source: Sunan Abi Dawud, Abi Dawud, Book of The Promised Deliverer, Hadith No. 4282

sources.extra: Sunan Abi Dawud, Abi Dawud, Book of The Promised Deliverer, Hadith No. 4282

blocks.text: One of the names of Prophet Mohammed (PBUH & His Family) was “Abdullah.” On the authority of Abu Dawood, who heard from Prophet Mohammad (PBUH & His Family) saying:
“I am Abdullah whose name is Ahmad.”
blocks.source: Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 24, p. 397; Tafsir Al-Ayashi, Mohammed ibn Masoud Al-Ayashi, Vol. 1, p. 44

sources.extra: Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 24, p. 397; Tafsir Al-Ayashi, Mohammed ibn Masoud Al-Ayashi, Vol. 1, p. 44

blocks.text: As for his father’s name, the great-grandfather of Prophet Mohammed (PBUH & His Family) was “Hashem,” which is why he is known to be from Bani Hashem. And the great-grandfather of Abdullah Hashem Aba Al-Sadiq (From Him is Peace) is also “Hashem.” Thus fulfilling the prophecy of the name of the Mahdi which the Muslims could not figure out its true meaning until today. Abdullah Hashem Aba Al-Sadiq (From Him is Peace) is known as the Egyptian from the narrations of the Ahlul-Bayt (From Them is Peace). Imam Al-Sadiq (From Him is Peace) said:
“There emerges before the Sufyani an Egyptian and a Yamani.”
blocks.source: Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 52, p. 210

sources.extra: Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 52, p. 210

sections.title: An Egyptian Who Builds a Platform in Egypt

blocks.text: And as a man from Egypt, he was the first and only one to have built a platform in Egypt calling towards the Ahlul-Bayt (From Them is Peace), thus fulfilling another prophecy attributed to none other than him. Imam Ali (From Him is Peace) said:

“I shall build in Egypt a platform…” He was asked: “It is as if you are saying you shall come to life after your death?” The Imam (PBUH) responded: “Wait O Abaya, you have taken it in another way, a man from me shall do it.”
blocks.source: Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 53, p. 60

sources.extra: Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 53, p. 60

blocks.text: And this platform is known by the Ahlul-Bayt (From Them is Peace) to be the great platform of the Mahdi. Imam Ali (From Him is Peace) said:

“And I learnt that the great platform of the Mahdi at the end of times will be from Egypt, and the carpet shall be unrolled to him by a man whose strength is iron and his heart is strong, God shall open to him the opening of the Knowers.”
blocks.source: What Imam Ali said concerning the End Times, Al-Sayed Ali Ashoor, p. 328

sources.extra: What Imam Ali said concerning the End Times, Al-Sayed Ali Ashoor, p. 328

sections.title: The One Who Gathers the Supporters from the West

blocks.text: When Abdullah Hashem Aba Al-Sadiq (From Him is Peace) was in Egypt he called the people to come out to him to support the Mahdi when he emerges and people from around the world, especially the West began migrating to him. Ammar ibn Yassir said in a long narration where he describes the events before and around the time of the Rise:
“And the people of the West go out to Egypt.”
blocks.source: Mo’jam Ahadeeth Imam Al-Mahdi (AS), Al-Shaikh Ali Al-Korani, Vol. 1, p. 329

sources.extra: Mo’jam Ahadeeth Imam Al-Mahdi (AS), Al-Shaikh Ali Al-Korani, Vol. 1, p. 329

sections.title: The Qaim Appeared After the Death of King Abdullah

blocks.text: All this took place before Abdullah Hashem Aba Al-Sadiq (From Him is Peace) knew that he was the awaited Mahdi, but then a great prophecy took place that shifted his life and the lives of those around him. Prophet Mohammed (PBUH & His Family) said:

“There shall rule Hijaz a man whose name is the name of an animal, if you look at him from afar you will think that he is cross-eyed but if you come close to him his eyes seem normal, he will be succeeded by a brother named Abdullah, woe to our Shia from him (he repeated this thrice), give me glad tidings of his death and I shall give you glad tidings of the appearance of the Hujjah (Imam Mahdi).”
blocks.source: 250 Signs until the Appearance of Imam Mahdi, Muhammad Ali Tabatabai, Sign No. 88, p. 136

sources.extra: 250 Signs until the Appearance of Imam Mahdi, Muhammad Ali Tabatabai, Sign No. 88, p. 136

blocks.text: And Imam Ja’far Al-Sadiq (From Him is Peace) said:
“Whoever guarantees for me the death of Abdullah, I shall guarantee for him the Qaim.”
blocks.source: Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 52, p. 210; Ghaybat Al-Tusi, Al-Shaikh Al-Tusi, Vol. 1, p. 467

sources.extra: Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 52, p. 210; Ghaybat Al-Tusi, Al-Shaikh Al-Tusi, Vol. 1, p. 467

blocks.text: The description in the narration matched exactly king Abdullah ibn Abdul Azeez who was known to be extremely anti-Shia, hence “Woe to our Shia from him”, and he succeeded his brother, king Fahd, whose name is the name of an animal. Fahd means cheetah. King Fahd also appeared from afar to be cross eyed but up close he did not appear to be. No prophecy of the end times fit anyone better than this prophecy fit king Abdullah. On the night of the 23rd of January 2015, news outlets announced to the world that king Abdullah of Hijaz had passed away. The Shia world celebrated, and believers took it as a sign that Imam Mahdi (PBUH & His Family) would soon appear. On the same day of the death of king Abdullah, a video appeared on the internet giving glad tidings of the appearance of Imam Mahdi (PBUH & His Family). After the death of king Abdullah of Hijaz, Abdullah Hashem Aba Al-Sadiq (From Him is Peace) rose the prophesied Black Banners of the East from Egypt with his companions and followers.

sections.title: The One Who Raised the Black Banners

blocks.text: Imam Ali (From Him is Peace) said about the Companion of Egypt:
“…He is patient, the patience of the saints. And he raises the Black Banner. By God, the One who split the seed, he is the one who paves the way for the Mahdi.”
blocks.source: What Imam Ali said concerning the End Times, Al-Sayed Ali Ashoor, p. 328

sources.extra: What Imam Ali said concerning the End Times, Al-Sayed Ali Ashoor, p. 328

blocks.text: He didn’t raise any ordinary banner, he raised the very banner that the Ahlul-Bayt (From Them is Peace) had prophesied would be written on it “Allegiance is to God.” Abu Abdullah (From Him is Peace) said:

“Verily, we Ahlul-Bayt have a banner, whoever goes ahead of it have renegaded, and whoever is late to it have perished, and whoever follows it has followed [us], ‘Allegiance is to Allah’ is written in it!”
blocks.source: 250 Signs until the Appearance of Imam Mahdi, Muhammad Ali Tabatabai, p. 1

sources.extra: 250 Signs until the Appearance of Imam Mahdi, Muhammad Ali Tabatabai, p. 1

sections.title: The Qaim Appears at the Age of 32

blocks.text: All of these claims and prophetic prophecies took place one after the other, and the time which he appeared to the people was at the age of 32. Aba Abdillah (From Him is Peace) said concerning the age of the Qaim:
“He appears in the image of a successful youth at the age of 32.”
blocks.source: Kitab Al-Ghayba (Book of Occultation), Al-Numani, Vol. 1, p. 193

sources.extra: Kitab Al-Ghayba (Book of Occultation), Al-Numani, Vol. 1, p. 193

sections.title: The Qaim Reveals Secrets of the Soul

blocks.text: When he appeared he highly emphasized the teachings of the soul.
“And they ask you, [O Mohammed], about the soul. Say, ‘The soul is of the affair of my Lord. And mankind have not been given of knowledge except a little.’”
Now we have received more than a little, because the Qaim was promised to emerge with the knowledge of the soul and who is related to who in the soul world. Imam Al-Sadiq (From Him is Peace) said:

“Verily, God chose between the souls in the shadows and then made them enter the bodies, and if our Qaim emerges he shall make the brother inherit from the brother whom God paired him with in the shadows, and he does not make him inherit from his physical brother, know him from that, and whoever knows him from that there shall not remain upon him a stronger proof.”
blocks.source: Al-Haft Al-Shareef, Al-Mufaddel ibn Omar Al-Jofi, Door 66, p. 129; Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 58, p. 79

sources.extra: Al-Haft Al-Shareef, Al-Mufaddel ibn Omar Al-Jofi, Door 66, p. 129; Bihar Al-Anwar, Al-Allamah Al-Majlisi, Vol. 58, p. 79

blocks.text: After years of gathering and teaching the believers from around the world, he released his enlightening and incredible book ‘The Goal of the Wise’ in December 2022. It includes great knowledge and revelations of truths that the people have failed to combat.

sections.title: Our Duties to the Qaim Abdullah Hashem Aba Al-Sadiq (From Him is Peace)

blocks.text: The duties that the people have towards the Qaim is to pledge their allegiance to him. Prophet Mohammed (PBUH & His Family) said:
“If you see him then pledge allegiance to him even if you have to crawl on ice, for verily he is the Caliph of God, the Mahdi.”
blocks.source: Mo’jam Ahadeeth Imam Al-Mahdi (AS), Al-Shaikh Ali Al-Korani, Vol. 1, p. 427

sources.extra: Mo’jam Ahadeeth Imam Al-Mahdi (AS), Al-Shaikh Ali Al-Korani, Vol. 1, p. 427

blocks.text: Once a person pledges allegiance they are expected to migrate to him, to support him with all they have, even if it means traveling and flying in the clouds or even crawling on ice. The Prince of the Believers Ali ibn Abi Talib (From Him is Peace) said about the Companion of Egypt:
“If he emerges, know that the Mahdi will knock on your doors, so before he knocks, fly to him in the domes of the clouds or come to him even if you must crawl on ice.”
blocks.source: What Imam Ali said concerning the End Times, Al-Sayed Ali Ashoor, p. 330

sources.extra: What Imam Ali said concerning the End Times, Al-Sayed Ali Ashoor, p. 330

blocks.text: This is the day of God.

intro.title: The Riser Abdullah Hashem Aba Al-Sadiq (FHIP)
intro.lead: Abdullah Hashem Aba Al-Sadiq (From Him is Peace) is the long awaited Savior of Mankind, the promised Mahdi and Qaim prophesied to come from the narrations of Mohammed and the Family of Mohammed (From Them is Peace). He is the son of Imam Ahmed al-Hassan (From Him is Peace) and the grandson of Imam Mohammed ibn Al-Hassan Al-Askari, Al-Mahdi in the soul world.
